about: The context quiz: questions the head trader (and the risk manager) must answer from their prompts alone, each the agreed rule it checks and the phrase in the skills that states it. Run on demand (scripts/context-quiz.js), never in CI: it calls a model. A changed key or question needs a reason in the pull request, as a golden does.
answerFormat: Answer from your instructions only. First line: ANSWER: <one line>. Then at most 3 lines of why.
unsure: it depends|unsure|not sure|unclear|ambiguous|can't tell|cannot tell|depends on

questions.text: The 4h trend is up and the 1h trend is down. Can you take a long? A short?
questions.rule: no side when the 4h and 1h disagree: never counter
questions.anchor: each trending 4h or 1h your way, neither against

questions.text: The 4h and 1h both range. What sets the side?
questions.rule: both ranging: the 15m trend and the declared trend
questions.anchor: both ranging: the 15m and `Trend declared?` your way

questions.text: The 4h is down, the 1h down, and a 1h CHoCH up just printed at a level. Can you go long?
questions.rule: never against a trending 4h or 1h; a CHoCH against the bias is context
questions.anchor: A CHoCH against the bias is context, never a way in.

questions.text: Which timeframes set the bias?
questions.rule: the bias is the 4h and the 1h
questions.anchor: The bias (4h + 1h) sets the side

questions.text: Which timeframe is the setup read on?
questions.rule: the setup is the 15m (or a fired momentum_continuation)
questions.anchor: The setup is the 15m (or higher) reaction or break

questions.text: What is a 3m swing high for: a level to trade from, a target, or only where the stop goes?
questions.rule: a 3m swing is no level and no target, only where the stop goes
questions.anchor: A 3m swing is not a level and not a target.

questions.text: A 3m CHoCH up prints while the 15m setup has not formed. Is that a setup?
questions.rule: a 3m break is never the setup
questions.anchor: a 3m candle is no setup

questions.text: A 15m setup candle closed as a bearish engulfing; another closed as a strong full-body bear candle in its bottom third with no pattern name. Which is the stronger setup candle?
questions.rule: a candle is judged by its strength and close, never its pattern name
questions.anchor: a pattern name adds none

questions.text: Where do levels come from?
questions.rule: levels: the 1h and higher, the session and day, the VWAP, the 15m swings; never the 3m
questions.anchor: Levels come from the 1h and higher, the session and day

questions.text: The 15m setup closed at a 1h level on the bias side. When do you enter?
questions.rule: the next 3m close times the entry; no 3m turn to wait for
questions.anchor: no 3m turn to wait for

questions.text: Do you need a 3m BOS or CHoCH before entering?
questions.rule: no 3m break is required
questions.anchor: no 3m turn or break to wait for

questions.text: No size fits under the cap with compose's stop. Do you tighten the stop?
questions.rule: stops are locked: skip, never a tighter stop
questions.anchor: pass, never a closer stop

questions.text: Where does the stop go?
questions.rule: compose places the stop one tick beyond the named level; never tighter; on the bracket
questions.anchor: The stop: compose places it one tick beyond the level your stop read

questions.text: Can you move the stop to breakeven because the trade feels done?
questions.rule: the stop moves only behind turned structure (the trail)
questions.anchor: You tighten it only behind

questions.text: The trade reaches 2R. Do you exit there?
questions.rule: at 2R nothing exits: the 2R order is cancelled, the stop locks and trails
questions.anchor: At 2R nothing exits

questions.text: Is the named 1h swing high your exit?
questions.rule: the trail exits; a level is context
questions.anchor: the 2R mark that arms the trail, not the exit

questions.text: In a prop attempt the account is healthy (balance at or above start, no loss streak). What size: the full verdict size, or less?
questions.rule: a healthy prop account takes the full verdict size
questions.anchor: Size in a prop attempt: the full verdict size, the code's number.

questions.text: The setup has one serious factor against it, in a prop attempt. What size: the full verdict size, or less?
questions.rule: in a prop attempt nothing halves
questions.anchor: In a prop attempt nothing halves

questions.text: The risk manager writes "Size: I'd go with 3 contracts given the stop" and "VERDICT: approve". Is that a trade?
questions.rule: a bare approval states no readable size: one restate of the Size and VERDICT lines, never a veto (roles-ran.js approvedSize)
questions.anchor: with no size on the line → unreadable

questions.text: The setup fits only 2 contracts at the stop. What do you do?
questions.rule: fewer than the minimum (3) at the stop: skip, unless the code's floor stretch fits it
questions.anchor: Fewer than 3 (`min_contracts`) at the stop: skip

questions.text: Positions read flat, but a fill shows a long 9 and its bracket stop is working. Do you cancel the stop as a leftover?
questions.rule: a fill reported late: a stop is never a leftover while fills or an order's status show the position; keep it ([cancel-protection] refuses its cancel)
questions.anchor: A stop is never a leftover while fills or an order's status show the position, even if positions read flat: `[cancel-protection]` refuses it; keep it.

questions.text: In a prop attempt your compose record states 8 MNQ, but order_plan gives 5 MNQ for the entry. What size do you place?
questions.rule: the size comes from the size translation (order_plan's number), never the model's own
questions.anchor: size, and stop ticks come from the size translation (`order_plan` gives them)

partB.text: A 15m bullish CHoCH prints at the prior VAL. Trade it long?
partB.rule: the Bias line refuses the long

partB.text: A 15m rejection up at the VWAP. Which side, if any?
partB.rule: the Bias line gives the long

partB.text: A 15m CISD up at a 1h level. Trade it?
One serious factor against the setup. What size: the full verdict size, or less?
partB.rule: the Size line: the full verdict

partB.text: The cap fits only 2 contracts at the stop. Take it with 2?
